name.description:
The test case name is taken from the appended heading texts. If there is no preceding heading, "test" is used.
All names are unique within the test suite so they can be used for result reporting.

lineNumber.description: If loaded from a Markdown file, the line number of the fenced code block.

headings.description:
The text of the headings active at the point of this test code block. The first heading is the outermost one
and the latter ones (if any) are innermost (deeper nesting level) headings.

comment.description:
The text of Markdown (other than headings) associated with this test case. Note that this may contain
multiple lines.

source.description: The original test code from the fenced code block.

setup.description:
The setup portion of this case for KPI tests. This may initialize variables used in the #measure block, but
its time and memory usage is not itself measured.

If the setup block returns anything, it must be a {@link MicrobenchSpec spec} used for the measurements. Note
that the usage of {@link MicrobenchSpec#numIterations numIterations} is not allowed in the setup block because
the value of #times will be used as numIterations.

assert.description:
The assert portion of this case for KPI tests. This may use variables set in the setup block, and a special
result variable (`$result` for Java/JS, and `_result` for Python), which is the value returned from
the measure block.

times.description:
The number of times the measure block is executed (tight loop). This can be specified in the measure block
info (opening fenced code block line) and will be converted to {@link MicrobenchSpec#numIterations}. For example:

    ```measure 1M times, x: py-client PLAT-12345
    Str.concat("a", "b")
    ```

Would run the statement a million times and measure the total. This is necessary if the operation being tested
executes too fast and its time would be swamped by the measurement overhead. Ideally, the code being measured
should run for a second or more.

Custom setup of the spec should be done using the return value from the #setup block, which should be a made
{@link MicrobenchSpec} instance or an object initializer.

@see Num.parseCount

script.description: The script parsed from the source.

title:
A KpiCase used to measure C3 code. The setup, measure, and assert blocks of a PolyKpiCase must be authored in
Poly Test Script as they will be transpiled to all locations.
name: TestSuite.PolyKpiCase
